types.name: SugarFigureType
types.description: Whether a sugar figure is measured as added sugars or total sugars. Added sugars are added during processing; total sugars include naturally occurring sugars such as lactose.

values.description: A sugar figure type not otherwise modeled.

types.name: MilkService
types.description: How fluid milk is served to a child: as a beverage, on cereal, or a combination of both.

values.description: Fluid milk served as a beverage.
Fluid milk served as a combination of beverage and on cereal.
A manner of serving fluid milk not permitted.

types.name: MilkFatType
types.description: The fat content type of fluid milk served.

values.description: A milk fat type not otherwise modeled.

types.name: MealType
types.description: The type of meal being served in CACFP: breakfast, lunch, supper, or snack.

values.description: A meal type not otherwise modeled.

types.name: TipoComida
types.description: The type of meal or snack served in the Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP).

values.description: Any other meal type not explicitly modeled.

rules.alternateExpression: Fluid milk must be served as a beverage, on cereal, or a combination of both; no other manner of service is permitted.

rules.expression:
(=> (>= childAgeYears 6)
    (or (= milkFatType
           MilkFatType_WHOLE)
        (= milkFatType
           MilkFatType_REDUCED_FAT)
        (= milkFatType
           MilkFatType_LOW_FAT)
        (= milkFatType
           MilkFatType_FAT_FREE)))
rules.alternateExpression: Children who are 6 years old and older may be served whole, reduced-fat, low-fat, or fat-free milk, and the milk may be flavored or unflavored.
Flavored milk is not allowed for children aged 1 through 5 years.
Lactose-free and reduced-lactose milk that meet the fat content and flavor requirements for the child's age group may be served as fluid milk.
For children, yogurt does not count as fluid milk and may not be served in place of fluid milk.
One cup of leafy greens counts as one half cup of vegetables.
beansCountedAsVegetable is false or beansCountedAsMeatAlternate is false
One quarter cup of dried fruit counts as one half cup of fruit (dried fruit credits at double its volume).
Juice served at a second meal or snack in the same day does not credit toward the vegetable or fruit component.
All creditable grains must be made with enriched or whole grain meal or flour.
The daily whole grain-rich requirement is met if and only if at least one whole grain-rich grain was served that day.
Grain-based desserts are not creditable as grains.
A breakfast cereal is creditable as a grain only if it contains no more than 6 grams of added sugars per dry ounce.
A breakfast cereal containing more than 6 grams of added sugars per dry ounce is not creditable as a grain.
Acorns, chestnuts, and coconuts do not credit as meat alternates.
Non-commercial and non-standardized tofu and soy products are not creditable.
Four ounces by weight of yogurt equals one ounce equivalent of meats/meat alternates.
Yogurt may be plain or flavored, unsweetened or sweetened.
Yogurt is creditable as a meat alternate only if it contains no more than 12 grams of added sugars per 6 ounces.
A yogurt containing more than 12 grams of added sugars per 6 ounces is not creditable as a meat alternate.
Frozen yogurt, drinkable yogurt, homemade yogurt, yogurt flavored products, yogurt bars, yogurt covered fruits or nuts, and similar products are not creditable as yogurt.
Soy yogurt is creditable as a meat alternate only if it contains no more than 12 grams of added sugars per 6 ounces (the same limit as dairy yogurt).
Deep-fat fried foods prepared on-site cannot be part of a reimbursable meal.
Foods and beverages must not be used as punishments or rewards.
Under family style meal service, second meals may not be claimed for reimbursement.
A medical-statement substitution is reimbursable only if a written medical statement signed by a State licensed healthcare professional or registered dietitian has been provided.
Solid foods may be introduced when developmentally appropriate for the infant.
Infant cereal is creditable only if it is iron-fortified.
The meal type cannot be the unmodeled OTHER value.
If a meat or meat alternate replaces the grains component at breakfast a fourth time (or more) in the same week, that breakfast does not meet the grains requirement.
A reimbursable snack for a child must contain at least two of the five components.
A snack whose only two items are fluid milk and juice is not reimbursable.

rules.expression:
(=> (and (= mealType
            MealType_SNACK)
         snackHasFluidMilk
         snackHasJuice
         snackOnlyItemsAreMilkAndJuice)
    (not isMealReimbursable))
rules.alternateExpression: A snack consisting of fluid milk and juice (fruit or vegetable) is not reimbursable.
A snack containing only one component is not reimbursable.
if isInfant is true and foodDeepFatFriedOnSite is true, then isMealReimbursable is false
For infants, every meal and snack must include breastmilk or iron-fortified infant formula to be reimbursable.
An infant meal that includes fruit juice or vegetable juice is not reimbursable.
The whole grain-rich requirement does not apply to infants.
Cooked grains such as rice, quinoa, and pasta are not creditable in the infant meal pattern.
For infants, cheese food and cheese spread are not creditable as a meat alternate.
For infants, natural or processed cheese is creditable as a meat alternate.
cerealAddedSugarsPerDryOunce is at least 0
yogurtAddedSugarsPer6Ounces is at least 0
if isWholeGrainRich is true, then grainWholeGrainPercent is at least 50
if isWholeGrainRich is true, then grainWholeGrainPercent is no more than 100
if isWholeGrainRich is false, then grainWholeGrainPercent is less than 50 or grainWholeGrainPercent is greater than 100
if isMeatReplacingGrainsAtBreakfastAllowed is true, then meatReplacedGrainsAtBreakfastThisWeek is no more than 3
if isMeatReplacingGrainsAtBreakfastAllowed is false, then meatReplacedGrainsAtBreakfastThisWeek is greater than 3
if childAgeYears is equal to 1, then milkFatType is equal to MilkFatType_WHOLE
if childAgeYears is equal to 1, then milkIsFlavored is false
if childAgeYears is at least 2 and childAgeYears is no more than 5, then milkIsFlavored is false

rules.expression:
(=> (and (>= childAgeYears 2)
         (<= childAgeYears 5))
    (or (= milkFatType
           MilkFatType_WHOLE)
        (= milkFatType
           MilkFatType_REDUCED_FAT)
        (= milkFatType
           MilkFatType_LOW_FAT)
        (= milkFatType
           MilkFatType_FAT_FREE)))
rules.alternateExpression: if childAgeYears is at least 2 and childAgeYears is no more than 5, then at least one of the following 4 statements is true: 1) milkFatType is equal to MilkFatType_WHOLE; 2) milkFatType is equal to MilkFatType_REDUCED_FAT; 3) milkFatType is equal to MilkFatType_LOW_FAT; 4) milkFatType is equal to MilkFatType_FAT_FREE
if isMilkSubstituteAllowed is true, then milkSubstituteServed is true
if isMilkSubstituteAllowed is true, then hasWrittenParentRequest is true
if isMilkSubstituteAllowed is true, then substituteNutritionallyEquivalent is true

if isMilkSubstituteAllowed is false, then at least one of the following 3 statements is true: 1) milkSubstituteServed is false; 2) hasWrittenParentRequest is false; 3) substituteNutritionallyEquivalent is false
if isJuiceCreditable is true, then juiceIsPasteurized is true
if isJuiceCreditable is true, then juiceIsFullStrength is true
if isCommerciallyPreFriedFoodAllowed is true, then foodIsCommerciallyPreFried is true
if isCommerciallyPreFriedFoodAllowed is true, then reheatedByFrying is false
if isCommerciallyPreFriedFoodAllowed is false, then foodIsCommerciallyPreFried is false or reheatedByFrying is true
if mealType is equal to MealType_BREAKFAST and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsFluidMilk is true
if mealType is equal to MealType_BREAKFAST and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsVegetables is true or containsFruits is true
if mealType is equal to MealType_BREAKFAST and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsGrains is true
if mealType is equal to MealType_LUNCH and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsFluidMilk is true
if mealType is equal to MealType_LUNCH and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsMeatsMeatAlternates is true
if mealType is equal to MealType_LUNCH and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsVegetables is true
if mealType is equal to MealType_LUNCH and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsFruits is true
if mealType is equal to MealType_LUNCH and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsGrains is true
if mealType is equal to MealType_SUPPER and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsFluidMilk is true
if mealType is equal to MealType_SUPPER and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsMeatsMeatAlternates is true
if mealType is equal to MealType_SUPPER and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsVegetables is true
if mealType is equal to MealType_SUPPER and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsFruits is true
if mealType is equal to MealType_SUPPER and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsGrains is true
if vegetableServedToMeetFruitRequirement is true and mealType is equal to MealType_LUNCH, then twoVegetablesAreDifferentKinds is true
if vegetableServedToMeetFruitRequirement is true and mealType is equal to MealType_SUPPER, then twoVegetablesAreDifferentKinds is true
if isInfant is true, then infantMealPatternApplies is true
if isInfant is true, then childMealPatternApplies is false
if childMealPatternApplies is true, then childAgeYears is at least 1
if childMealPatternApplies is true, then childAgeYears is no more than 18
if parentSuppliesOneComponent is true and isMealReimbursable is true, then parentComponentMeetsRequirements is true
if parentSuppliesOneComponent is true and isMealReimbursable is true, then providerSuppliesRemainingComponents is true
Yogurt with no more than 12 grams of added sugars per 6 ounces is creditable as a meat alternate.
A breakfast cereal made with enriched or whole grain meal or flour, with no more than 6 grams of added sugars per dry ounce, is creditable as a grain.
A snack with two or more of the five components, that is not only milk and juice, is reimbursable.
A snack whose only two items are fluid milk and juice is not reimbursable.
The yogurt sugar limit is measured in added sugars, not total sugars; the former total sugars limit no longer applies.
The breakfast cereal sugar limit is measured in added sugars, not total sugars; the former total sugars limit no longer applies.

variables.name: childAgeYears
variables.description: The child's age in years. A child is a participant aged 1 year through 18 years.

variables.name: isInfant
variables.description: True if the participant is an infant, meaning aged birth through 11 months.

variables.name: containsFluidMilk
variables.description: True if the meal contains the fluid milk component.

variables.name: containsVegetables
variables.description: True if the meal contains the vegetables component.

variables.name: containsFruits
variables.description: True if the meal contains the fruits component.

variables.name: containsGrains
variables.description: True if the meal contains the grains component.

variables.name: containsMeatsMeatAlternates
variables.description: True if the meal contains the meats/meat alternates component.

variables.name: isMealReimbursable
variables.description: True if the meal is reimbursable, meaning it contains every component required for that meal type for a child.

variables.name: isFoodCreditable
variables.description: True if the food is creditable, meaning it may count toward a meal component.

variables.name: grainWholeGrainPercent
variables.description: The percent of a grain product's grain content that is whole grain. A product is whole grain-rich when this is between 50 and 100 percent, with any remaining grains being enriched.

variables.name: isWholeGrainRich
variables.description: True if the grain product is whole grain-rich (grain content between 50 and 100 percent whole grain with any remaining grains enriched).

variables.name: sugarFigureType
variables.description: Whether a referenced sugar quantity is measured as added sugars or total sugars.

variables.name: meatReplacedGrainsAtBreakfastThisWeek
variables.description: The number of times a meat or meat alternate has replaced the grains component at breakfast during the current week.

variables.name: isMeatReplacingGrainsAtBreakfastAllowed
variables.description: True if a meat or meat alternate may be served in place of the entire grains component at breakfast on this occasion (allowed only up to 3 times per week).

variables.name: vegetableServedToMeetFruitRequirement
variables.description: True if a vegetable is being served to meet the entire fruit requirement at lunch or supper.

variables.name: twoVegetablesAreDifferentKinds
variables.description: True if, when two vegetables are served to meet both the vegetable and fruit requirements at lunch or supper, the two vegetables are two different kinds of vegetable.

variables.name: snackComponentCount
variables.description: The number of distinct meal components (of the five) contained in a snack.

variables.name: snackHasFluidMilk
variables.description: True if the snack includes fluid milk.

variables.name: snackHasJuice
variables.description: True if the snack includes fruit juice or vegetable juice.

variables.name: snackOnlyItemsAreMilkAndJuice
variables.description: True if the only two items in the snack are fluid milk and juice (fruit or vegetable juice).

variables.name: milkService
variables.description: The manner in which fluid milk is served to the child.

variables.name: milkFatType
variables.description: The fat content type of the fluid milk served to the child.

variables.name: milkIsFlavored
variables.description: True if the fluid milk served is flavored, false if unflavored.

variables.name: isLactoseFreeOrReducedLactoseMilk
variables.description: True if the milk served is lactose-free or reduced-lactose milk.

variables.name: milkMeetsFatAndFlavorForAge
variables.description: True if the milk meets the fat content and flavor requirements for the child's age group.

variables.name: isMilkCreditableAsFluidMilk
variables.description: True if the milk may be served and counted as the fluid milk component.

variables.name: yogurtServedInPlaceOfFluidMilk
variables.description: True if yogurt is being served in place of fluid milk.

variables.name: milkSubstituteServed
variables.description: True if a fluid milk substitute such as soy milk is served for a non-disability reason.

variables.name: hasWrittenParentRequest
variables.description: True if there is a written request from the parent or guardian for the milk substitute.

variables.name: substituteNutritionallyEquivalent
variables.description: True if the milk substitute is nutritionally equivalent to milk as set out in 7 CFR 226.20(g)(3).

variables.name: isMilkSubstituteAllowed
variables.description: True if a fluid milk substitute served for a non-disability reason is permitted.

variables.name: isVegetableServingCreditable
variables.description: True if a vegetable serving (fresh, frozen, or canned vegetables, dry beans, peas, lentils, or vegetable juice) is creditable as a vegetable.

variables.name: leafyGreensCups
variables.description: The volume of leafy greens served, in cups.

variables.name: leafyGreensVegetableCredit
variables.description: The vegetable credit, in cups, attributed to leafy greens served.

variables.name: beansCountedAsVegetable
variables.description: True if cooked dry beans, peas, and lentils in a dish are counted as a vegetable.

variables.name: beansCountedAsMeatAlternate
variables.description: True if cooked dry beans, peas, and lentils in a dish are counted as a meat alternate.

variables.name: isFruitServingCreditable
variables.description: True if a fruit serving (fresh, frozen, canned, or dried fruits, or fruit juice) is creditable as a fruit.

variables.name: driedFruitCups
variables.description: The volume of dried fruit served, in cups.

variables.name: driedFruitFruitCredit
variables.description: The fruit credit, in cups, attributed to dried fruit served.

variables.name: juiceIsPasteurized
variables.description: True if the juice is pasteurized.

variables.name: juiceIsFullStrength
variables.description: True if the juice is full-strength.

variables.name: isJuiceCreditable
variables.description: True if the juice is creditable toward a vegetable or fruit component.

variables.name: juiceAlreadyServedToday
variables.description: True if fruit juice or vegetable juice was already served to meet the vegetable or fruit requirement at an earlier meal or snack on the same day.

variables.name: juiceCreditsThisOccasion
variables.description: True if the juice served at this meal or snack credits toward the vegetable or fruit component.

variables.name: grainMadeWithEnrichedOrWholeGrain
variables.description: True if the grain is made with enriched or whole grain meal or flour.

variables.name: isGrainCreditable
variables.description: True if the grain food is creditable toward the grains component.

variables.name: wholeGrainRichServedToday
variables.description: True if at least one whole grain-rich grain was served to the child during the day across all eating occasions.

variables.name: dailyWholeGrainRichRequirementMet
variables.description: True if the daily whole grain-rich requirement is met (at least one grain serving per day is whole grain-rich).

variables.name: isGrainBasedDessert
variables.description: True if the grain food is a grain-based dessert, such as cookies, cakes, brownies, doughnuts, sweet rolls, toaster pastries, or granola bars.

variables.name: cerealAddedSugarsPerDryOunce
variables.description: The grams of added sugars per dry ounce in a breakfast cereal.

variables.name: isBreakfastCerealCreditable
variables.description: True if the breakfast cereal is creditable as a grain.

variables.name: isMeatAlternateCreditable
variables.description: True if the food qualifies as a creditable meat or meat alternate (lean meat, poultry, fish, alternate protein products, cheese, eggs, cooked dry beans/peas/lentils, nut or seed butters, nuts and seeds, yogurt, commercial tofu and soy products).

variables.name: isAcornChestnutOrCoconut
variables.description: True if the food is an acorn, chestnut, or coconut.

variables.name: isNonCommercialOrNonStandardizedTofuSoy
variables.description: True if the tofu or soy product is non-commercial or non-standardized.

variables.name: yogurtOuncesByWeight
variables.description: The amount of yogurt served, measured in ounces by weight.

variables.name: yogurtOunceEquivalentCredit
variables.description: The ounce equivalent of meats/meat alternates credited from yogurt served (4 ounces by weight equals one ounce equivalent).

variables.name: yogurtMayBePlainOrFlavoredSweetenedOrUnsweetened
variables.description: True indicating yogurt may be plain or flavored, unsweetened or sweetened.

variables.name: yogurtAddedSugarsPer6Ounces
variables.description: The grams of added sugars per 6 ounces in a yogurt product.

variables.name: isYogurtCreditable
variables.description: True if the yogurt is creditable as a meat alternate.

variables.name: isNonCreditableYogurtProduct
variables.description: True if the product is frozen yogurt, a drinkable yogurt product, homemade yogurt, a yogurt flavored product, a yogurt bar, yogurt covered fruit or nuts, or a similar product.

variables.name: isSoyYogurt
variables.description: True if the yogurt is soy yogurt.

variables.name: foodDeepFatFriedOnSite
variables.description: True if the food was deep-fat fried (cooked by submerging in hot oil or other fat) on-site.

variables.name: foodIsCommerciallyPreFried
variables.description: True if the food was pre-fried, flash-fried, or par-fried by a commercial manufacturer.

variables.name: reheatedByFrying
variables.description: True if the commercially pre-fried food was reheated by frying.

variables.name: isCommerciallyPreFriedFoodAllowed
variables.description: True if the commercially pre-fried, flash-fried, or par-fried food may be served.

variables.name: foodUsedAsPunishmentOrReward
variables.description: True if foods or beverages are used as punishments or rewards.

variables.name: isFamilyStyleMealService
variables.description: True if the meal is served under family style meal service.

variables.name: isSecondMeal
variables.description: True if this is a second meal.

variables.name: isSecondMealClaimable
variables.description: True if a second meal may be claimed for reimbursement.

variables.name: modifiedMealMeetsMealPattern
variables.description: True if a modified meal meets the meal pattern. The document text for this rule is truncated and incomplete.

variables.name: cerealSugarLimitMeasure
variables.description: The sugar measure used for the breakfast cereal sugar limit; it must be added sugars, not total sugars.

variables.name: mealType
variables.description: The type of meal currently being served: breakfast, lunch, supper, or snack.

variables.name: yogurtSugarLimitMeasure
variables.description: The sugar measure used for the yogurt sugar limit; it must be added sugars, not total sugars.

variables.name: hasWrittenMedicalStatement
variables.description: True if a written medical statement signed by a State licensed healthcare professional or a registered dietitian has been provided to justify a substitution or accommodation.

variables.name: isSubstitutionReimbursable
variables.description: True if a meal substitution requiring a medical statement is reimbursable. Such a substitution is reimbursable only when a written medical statement signed by a State licensed healthcare professional or registered dietitian is provided.

variables.name: parentSuppliesOneComponent
variables.description: True if a parent or guardian supplies exactly one component of a meal for a non-disability reason.

variables.name: parentComponentMeetsRequirements
variables.description: True if the single component supplied by the parent or guardian meets the applicable meal pattern requirements.

variables.name: providerSuppliesRemainingComponents
variables.description: True if the provider supplies all of the remaining components of the meal that the parent or guardian did not supply.

variables.name: childMealPatternApplies
variables.description: True if the child meal pattern applies to the participant. The child meal pattern applies to children aged 1 through 18 and does not apply to infants.

variables.name: infantMealPatternApplies
variables.description: True if the separate infant meal pattern applies to the participant.

variables.name: breastmilkOrIronFortifiedFormulaServed
variables.description: True if breastmilk or iron-fortified infant formula is served at the infant meal or snack.

variables.name: juiceServed
variables.description: True if fruit juice or vegetable juice is served in the meal.

variables.name: wholeGrainRichRequirementApplies
variables.description: True if the whole grain-rich requirement applies to the participant. It applies only to the child and adult meal patterns, not to infants.

variables.name: cookedGrainServed
variables.description: True if a cooked grain such as rice, quinoa, or pasta is served.

variables.name: isCookedGrainCreditable
variables.description: True if cooked grains are creditable. In the infant meal pattern, cooked grains are not creditable.

variables.name: cheeseFoodOrSpreadServed
variables.description: True if cheese food or cheese spread is served as a meat alternate.

variables.name: naturalOrProcessedCheeseServed
variables.description: True if natural or processed cheese is served as a meat alternate.

variables.name: isCheeseFoodOrSpreadCreditableForInfants
variables.description: True if cheese food or cheese spread is creditable as a meat alternate for infants.

variables.name: isNaturalOrProcessedCheeseCreditableForInfants
variables.description: True if natural or processed cheese is creditable as a meat alternate for infants.

variables.name: solidFoodsMayBeIntroduced
variables.description: True if solid foods may be introduced to the infant, which is around 6 months of age or earlier/later when developmentally appropriate.

variables.name: isDevelopmentallyAppropriate
variables.description: True if introducing solid foods is developmentally appropriate for the infant.

variables.name: infantCerealIsIronFortified
variables.description: True if the infant cereal served is iron-fortified.

variables.name: isInfantCerealCreditable
variables.description: True if the infant cereal served is creditable. Infant cereal must be iron-fortified to be creditable.
